headline: Weight Surgery: the α sweep lands, honest by construction
lede: On the surgery lab, step 3's scaling sweep ran end-to-end under Jon's choose-on-practice ruling: four models, one fresh 64-problem batch, one frozen pick. α=4 won practice 6.2% vs base 0.0% — and it is the only variant that ever sees the held-out set.

notes.text: basew control closed the window question: base at the whole-generation penalty window scores MATH 6.0% / GSM 10.0% — accuracy lifts, escape does not. #1562's own-edit 'doubled MATH' was the protocol, not the edit.

Practice sweep: base 0.0/0.0, α2 3.1/6.2, α4 6.2/6.2, α8 1.6/4.7 — the linear direction responds to scaling then breaks past α=4. Frozen accuracy-first pick (written before any row existed) chose α4; 11 of 20 Astra passes spent, every one logged with what it ruled out.
Harness law #1567: a swept α with a held-out row is now a RED build — test-set tuning is provable not to have happened, not just disclosed. ws3check 90→104.
α4's held-out 100+100 row is scoring detached now; the follow-up PR lands it against the p50cw 31.0 reference and closes #1567.
